verdict.rationale: smolagents is an open-source Python library that supports any LLM (local transformers/ollama or API-based via LiteLLM), runs code execution locally or via self-hostable sandboxes (Docker, E2B, Modal, Blaxel), and has no mandatory vendor platform dependency — Hub push/pull and telemetry are optional. missing for 10: explicit independent/hands-on confirmation of a fully air-gapped deployment with zero Hub calls, and clearer documentation distinguishing optional vs required Hub/telemetry integrations.
